questions.question: A cash payment that will settle a bill for 625 pairs of boots at ₹94 per pair of boots with successive discounts of 20% and 7% with a further discount of 20% on cash payment is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Successive multipliers = 0.80 × 0.93 × 0.80

Net factor = 0.5952

Total marked amount = 625 × 94 = 58750

Final payment = 58750 × 0.5952 = 34956

**∴ Answer = ₹34956**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Price per pair = 94, Quantity = 625; Discounts = 20%, 7%, 20%

**Formula used:**

Final price = Marked price × (1 − d₁) × (1 − d₂) × (1 − d₃)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total price = 625 × 94 = 58750

⇒ After 20% discount: 58750 × 0.80 = 47000

⇒ After 7% discount: 47000 × 0.93 = 43710

⇒ After 20% discount: 43710 × 0.80 = 34968

**∴ The correct answer is ₹34968.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discounts

Multiply remaining percentages: (1 − d/100)

Net Multiplier

Overall factor = product of all discount factors

Bulk Calculation

Compute total price first, then apply discounts

Common Mistake

Do not add discounts directly; apply successively

questions.question: The average age of 31 students of a class is 30 years. If the age of the teacher is also included, the average age of the whole group becomes 31 years. The age (in years) of the teacher is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total age of students = 31 × 30 = 930

New total (including teacher) = 32 × 31 = 992

Teacher’s age = 992 − 930 = 62

**∴ Answer = 62 years**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of students = 31, Average = 30; New average = 31

**Formula used:**

Total = Average × Number

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total age of students = 31 × 30 = 930

⇒ Total age including teacher = 32 × 31 = 992

⇒ Teacher’s age = 992 − 930 = 62

**∴ The correct answer is 62 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Formula

Average = Total ÷ Number

Total Calculation

Total = Average × Number

Increment Method

Extra total = Increase in average × new number

Quick Tip

Teacher’s age = increase in total after inclusion

questions.question: The price of fuel decreases by 45%, 35% and 30% in three successive months, but increases by 45% in the fourth month. What is the percentage increase/decrease in the price of fuel in the fourth month as compared to its original price? (Round off the answer to two decimal places.)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Take initial price = 100

Apply multipliers ⇒ 100 × 0.55 × 0.65 × 0.70 × 1.45

= 100 × 0.3631375 = 36.31375

Net change = 36.31375 − 100 = −63.68625%

**∴ Answer = 63.69% decrease**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Successive changes: −45%, −35%, −30%, +45%

**Formula used:**

Final value = Initial × product of multipliers

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let initial price = 100

⇒ After 1st: 100 × 0.55 = 55

⇒ After 2nd: 55 × 0.65 = 35.75

⇒ After 3rd: 35.75 × 0.70 = 25.025

⇒ After 4th: 25.025 × 1.45 = 36.28625

⇒ Net change = 36.28625 − 100 = −63.71375

⇒ ≈ −63.71%

**∴ The correct answer is 63.71% decrease.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Change

Use multipliers: (1 − p/100) for decrease, (1 + p/100) for increase

Multiplicative Effect

Changes are applied sequentially, not added

Shortcut Tip

Assume base value = 100 for easy calculation

Rounding Rule

Round final percentage to two decimal places

questions.question: The sides of two squares are (4 + sqrt{3}) cm and (4 - sqrt{3}) cm, respectively. What is the sum of the areas of these two squares?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use identity: (a + b)² + (a − b)² = 2(a² + b²)

Here a = 4, b = √3

⇒ Sum of areas = 2(4² + (√3)²)

= 2(16 + 3) = 2 × 19 = 38

**∴ Answer = 38 cm²**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sides = (4 + √3) cm and (4 − √3) cm

**Formula used:**

Area of square = side²

**Calculation:**

⇒ Area₁ = (4 + √3)² = 16 + 3 + 8√3 = 19 + 8√3

⇒ Area₂ = (4 − √3)² = 16 + 3 − 8√3 = 19 − 8√3

⇒ Sum = (19 + 8√3) + (19 − 8√3)

⇒ = 38

**∴ The correct answer is 38 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Identity Used

(a + b)² + (a − b)² = 2(a² + b²)

Square Expansion

(a ± b)² = a² ± 2ab + b²

Simplification Trick

Opposite surds cancel when added

Application

Useful in symmetric algebraic expressions

questions.question: In quadrilateral PQRS, the bisectors of ∠R and ∠S meet at the point T (inside the quadrilateral) and ∠STR = 22.5°. If the ratio of ∠P to ∠Q is 4 : 5, then what is the difference between the measures of ∠Q and ∠P?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The angle between the bisectors of two adjacent angles of a quadrilateral is half the sum of the remaining two angles.

⇒ ∠P + ∠Q = 2 × ∠STR = 2 × 22.5° = 45°

The ratio of ∠P : ∠Q is given as 4 : 5, which means a total of 9 units.

⇒ 9 units = 45° ⇒ 1 unit = 5°

⇒ Difference (∠Q − ∠P) = 5 − 4 = 1 unit = 5°

**∴ The correct answer is 5°.**

questions.question: If an X-m long train running at a speed of 63 m/s crosses a railway platform in 28 sec, find the value of X, if the length of the railway platform is 213 m.3704
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total distance = speed × time = 63 × 28 = 1764 m

Total distance = train length + platform length

⇒ X + 213 = 1764

⇒ X = 1764 − 213 = 1551 m

**∴ Answer = 1551 m**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed = 63 m/sec, Time = 28 sec, Platform length = 213 m

**Formula used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total distance covered = 63 × 28 = 1764 m

⇒ Total distance = Train length + Platform length

⇒ 1764 = X + 213

⇒ X = 1764 − 213

⇒ X = 1551 m

**∴ The correct answer is 1551 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Train Crossing Platform

questions.question: The cost price of a toy car is 80% of its selling price. If the selling price is ₹100, what is the profit percentage?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

CP = 80% of SP ⇒ CP = 80

SP = 100

Profit = 100 − 80 = 20

Profit% = (20 ÷ 80) × 100 = 25%

**∴ Answer = 25%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

SP = 100, CP = 80% of SP

**Formula used:**

Profit% = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ CP = 80% of 100 = 80

⇒ Profit = SP − CP = 100 − 80 = 20

⇒ Profit% = (20 ÷ 80) × 100

⇒ = 25%

**∴ The correct answer is 25%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

questions.question: A basket contains 42 fruits, which are either apples or oranges. If there are 6 more apples than oranges, how many oranges are there?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Difference = 6, Total = 42

Let oranges = x ⇒ apples = x + 6

x + (x + 6) = 42 ⇒ 2x + 6 = 42

⇒ 2x = 36 ⇒ x = 18

**∴ Answer = 18 oranges**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total fruits = 42, Apples are 6 more than oranges

**Formula used:**

Linear equation

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let oranges = x

⇒ Apples = x + 6

⇒ Total = x + (x + 6) = 42

⇒ 2x + 6 = 42

⇒ 2x = 36

⇒ x = 18

**∴ The correct answer is 18 oranges.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Linear Equation

Equation with one variable can be solved directly

Translation

Convert words into algebraic expressions

Key Idea

Sum of parts equals total

Quick Check

18 oranges, 24 apples ⇒ total 42 ✔

questions.question: A, B and C can do a piece of work in 3, 12 and 12 days, respectively. How long (in days) will they take to do twice the same work, working together?
questions.solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Let total work = LCM(3, 12, 12) = 12 units. Total efficiency of (A + B + C) = (12 ÷ 3) + (12 ÷ 12) + (12 ÷ 12) = 4 + 1 + 1 = 6 units/day. Time taken to complete the normal work = 12 ÷ 6 = 2 days. Time taken to complete twice the work = 2 × 2 = 4 days. **∴ The correct answer is 4 days.**

questions.question: If A can complete a task in 10 days and B is 25% more efficient than A, how long (in days) will it take them to complete 60% of the task when they work together?
questions.solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Ratio of efficiency of A : B = 100 : 125 = 4 : 5 Total work = Efficiency of A × Days taken by A = 4 × 10 = 40 units. 60% of Total Work = 40 × (60 ÷ 100) = 24 units. Combined efficiency = 4 + 5 = 9 units/day. Required time = 24 ÷ 9 = 8/3 = 2(2)/(3) days. **∴ The correct answer is 2(2)/(3) days.**

questions.question: The median of the following observations 46, 64, 87, 41, 58, 77, 35, 90, 55, 92, 33 is 58. If 92 is replaced by 99 and 41 by 43 in the given data, then the new median is:

Total numbers = 11 ⇒ Median = 6th term

Only extreme values changed (92→99, 41→43)

Middle position remains unaffected

6th term stays same ⇒ 58

**∴ Answer = 58**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

11 observations; Median = 6th term

**Concept Used:**

Median = middle value after arranging data

**Calculation:**

⇒ Original ordered data: 33, 35, 41, 46, 55, 58, 64, 77, 87, 90, 92

⇒ Replace 92 by 99 and 41 by 43

⇒ New ordered data: 33, 35, 43, 46, 55, 58, 64, 77, 87, 90, 99

⇒ 6th term = 58

**∴ The correct answer is 58.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Median Position

For odd n, median = (n+1)/2 term

Key Insight

Changing extreme values often does not affect median

Sorting Rule

Always arrange data before finding median

Quick Tip

Focus on middle term, not entire dataset

questions.question: A car covers three different segments of a journey: it travels 40 km at a speed of 60 km/hr, then 50 km at a speed of 50 km/hr and finally 60 km at a speed of 40 km/hr. What is the car's average speed (rounded off to one decimal place) for the entire trip?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Average speed = Total distance ÷ Total time

Total distance = 40 + 50 + 60 = 150 km

Total time = 40/60 + 50/50 + 60/40

= 2/3 + 1 + 3/2 = 19/6 hr

Avg speed = 150 ÷ (19/6) = 900/19 ≈ 47.4 km/hr

**∴ Answer = 47.4 km/hr**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Distances = 40 km, 50 km, 60 km; Speeds = 60, 50, 40 km/hr

**Formula used:**

Average speed = Total distance ÷ Total time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total distance = 40 + 50 + 60 = 150 km

⇒ Time₁ = 40/60 = 2/3 hr

⇒ Time₂ = 50/50 = 1 hr

⇒ Time₃ = 60/40 = 3/2 hr

⇒ Total time = 2/3 + 1 + 3/2 = 19/6 hr

⇒ Average speed = 150 ÷ (19/6)

⇒ = 150 × 6/19 = 900/19 ≈ 47.4 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 47.4 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed

Average speed = Total distance ÷ Total time

Key Point

Do not take simple average of speeds unless time is equal

Fraction Handling

Convert times into fractions for accuracy

Rounding

Round final answer to one decimal place

questions.question: What is the number of ordered pairs (x, y) where x, y are positive integers such that the eight digit number 74x8935y is divisible by 11?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use rule of 11 ⇒ (odd sum − even sum) = 0, ±11

Odd = 21 + x, Even = 15 + y ⇒ Difference = 6 + x − y

So 6 + x − y = 0 or ±11

⇒ x − y = -6 or 5

Valid digit pairs ⇒ 7 pairs

**∴ Answer = 7**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number = 74x8935y; x, y are digits (1 to 9)

**Formula used:**

Divisibility rule of 11: (Sum of odd places − sum of even places) = 0 or ±11

**Calculation:**

⇒ Odd positions: 7 + x + 9 + 5 = 21 + x

⇒ Even positions: 4 + 8 + 3 + y = 15 + y

⇒ Difference = (21 + x) − (15 + y)

⇒ = 6 + x − y

⇒ For divisibility: 6 + x − y = 0, 11, or −11

⇒ x − y = -6 or 5

⇒ Case 1: x − y = 5 ⇒ (6,1), (7,2), (8,3), (9,4)

⇒ Case 2: x − y = -6 ⇒ (1,7), (2,8), (3,9)

⇒ Total ordered pairs = 4 + 3 = 7

**∴ The correct answer is 7.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divisibility Rule of 11

Difference of alternate digit sums must be 0 or ±11

Modulo Concept

a ≡ b (mod 11) means their difference is divisible by 11

Digit Constraints

Digits must lie between 1 and 9

Key Insight

Check all possible integer cases satisfying modular equation

questions.question: What is the number of natural numbers less than or equal to 1000 and divisible by 5 or 7?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use inclusion-exclusion

Multiples of 5 = 1000 ÷ 5 = 200

Multiples of 7 = 1000 ÷ 7 = 142

Common (35) = 1000 ÷ 35 = 28

Total = 200 + 142 − 28 = 314

**∴ Answer = 314**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Numbers ≤ 1000 divisible by 5 or 7

**Formula used:**

n(A ∪ B) = n(A) + n(B) − n(A ∩ B)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Multiples of 5 = ⌊1000/5⌋ = 200

⇒ Multiples of 7 = ⌊1000/7⌋ = 142

⇒ Multiples of 35 = ⌊1000/35⌋ = 28

⇒ Total = 200 + 142 − 28

⇒ = 314

**∴ The correct answer is 314.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Inclusion-Exclusion Principle

n(A ∪ B) = n(A) + n(B) − n(A ∩ B)

LCM Concept

Common multiples use LCM (5 × 7 = 35)

Floor Function

⌊n/m⌋ gives count of multiples

Key Idea

Subtract overlap to avoid double counting

questions.question: If each edge of a cube is increased by 10%, then the percentage increase in its surface area is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Surface area is a 2D measure, so we can apply the successive percentage formula: a + b + (a × b) ÷ 100.

Since the edge is increased by 10%, we substitute a = 10 and b = 10.

Net percentage increase = 10 + 10 + (10 × 10) ÷ 100

Net percentage increase = 20 + 1 = 21%

**∴ The correct answer is 21%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Each edge of the cube is increased by 10%.

**Formula Used:**

Surface area of a cube = 6a², where a is the edge.

 
 10 unit
 Original Edge
 S.A. = 600

 
• 
 

 +10% Edge

 
 11 unit
 New Edge
 S.A. = 726
 
 Percentage Increase in Area = 21%

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the initial edge of the cube be a.

⇒ Initial surface area = 6a²

⇒ New edge of the cube = a + 10% of a = 1.1a

⇒ New surface area = 6 × (1.1a)²

⇒ New surface area = 6 × 1.21a² = 7.26a²

⇒ Increase in surface area = 7.26a² − 6a² = 1.26a²

⇒ Percentage increase = (Increase ÷ Initial Area) × 100

⇒ Percentage increase = (1.26a² ÷ 6a²) × 100

⇒ Percentage increase = 0.21 × 100 = 21%

**∴ The correct answer is 21%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Change

When a value is changed by a% and b% successively, the effective percentage change is calculated using the formula: (a + b + ab÷100)%.

Percentage Increase in Volume

Since the volume of a cube depends on the cube of its edge (a³), a 10% increase in the edge results in a net volume increase of 33.1% (calculated as 1.1³ = 1.331).

Scaling Properties

For any similar solid figure, if the linear dimensions are multiplied by a factor k, the surface area gets multiplied by k² and the volume is multiplied by k³.

questions.question: The sum of the ages of a daughter and her mother is 56 years. After 8 years, the age of the mother will be three times that of the daughter. Find the daughter's present age (in years).
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let daughter = D, mother = M

M + D = 56

After 8 yrs ⇒ M + 8 = 3(D + 8)

⇒ M = 3D + 16

Put in sum ⇒ 3D + 16 + D = 56 ⇒ 4D = 40 ⇒ D = 10

**∴ Answer = 10 years**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sum of ages = 56; After 8 years: Mother = 3 × Daughter

**Formula used:**

Linear equations

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let daughter’s age = x

⇒ Mother’s age = 56 − x

⇒ After 8 years: 56 − x + 8 = 3(x + 8)

⇒ 64 − x = 3x + 24

⇒ 64 − 24 = 3x + x

⇒ 40 = 4x

⇒ x = 10

**∴ The correct answer is 10 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Age Problems

Translate conditions into equations carefully

Linear Equation

Solve step by step by isolating variables

Future Age

Add same number of years to both persons

Verification

Check by substituting values

questions.question: From a point 30 m away from the base of a tree, the angle of elevation of the top of the tree is 60°. Find the height of the tree (take √3 = 1.73).
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In a 30°-60°-90° right-angled triangle, the sides opposite to the angles are in the ratio 1 : √3 : 2.

The side adjacent to 60° (opposite to 30°) represents the base = 1 part = 30 m.

The side opposite to 60° represents the height of the tree = √3 parts = 30 × √3.

Height = 30 × 1.73 = 51.9 m.

**∴ The correct answer is 51.9 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 
 
 60° A B (Base) C (Top) 30 m h = ? 

**Given:**

Distance of the point from the base of the tree (AB) = 30 m

Angle of elevation of the top of the tree (∠CAB) = 60°

**Formula Used:**

tan(θ) = Perpendicular ÷ Base

**Calculations:**

Let the height of the tree (BC) be h.

In right-angled triangle ABC:

⇒ tan(60°) = BC ÷ AB

⇒ √3 = h ÷ 30

⇒ h = 30 × √3

Using the given value √3 = 1.73:

⇒ h = 30 × 1.73

⇒ h = 51.9 m

**∴ The correct answer is 51.9 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Angle of Elevation

The angle formed by the line of sight with the horizontal when the observer looks upward at an object.

Angle of Depression

The angle formed by the line of sight with the horizontal when the observer looks downward at an object. The angle of elevation from an object to an observer is equal to the angle of depression from the observer to the object.

Important Trigonometric Values

tan(30°) = 1 ÷ √3 | tan(45°) = 1 | tan(60°) = √3

questions.question: (1)/(30) { is what percentage of } (1)/(90)?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

To find what percent a value X is of a base Y, simply divide X by Y and multiply by 100.

Required % = (1/30 ÷ 1/90) × 100

⇒ Required % = (1/30 × 90) × 100

⇒ 3 × 100 = 300%

**∴ The correct answer is 300%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Target value to compare = 1/30

Base value = 1/90

**Formula Used:**

Percentage = (Target Value ÷ Base Value) × 100

 Base = 1/90 100% Target Value = 1/30 
 1/90 1/90 1/90 Total = 3 × Base = 300% 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Required Percentage = (1/30 ÷ 1/90) × 100

⇒ Convert division of fraction to multiplication by taking reciprocal of 1/90.

⇒ Required Percentage = (1/30 × 90/1) × 100

⇒ Required Percentage = (90 ÷ 30) × 100

⇒ Required Percentage = 3 × 100

⇒ Required Percentage = 300%

**∴ The correct answer is 300%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

What Percentage is X of Y?

To find what percentage a value X is of a base value Y, use the standard formula: (X ÷ Y) × 100. Ensure both quantities are in the same unit format before calculating.

Percentage Increase or Decrease

Formula: (Difference ÷ Original Value) × 100. The original value is always taken as the base denominator. Increase happens when the new value is greater, and decrease happens when the original value is greater.

Fraction to Percentage Conversion

To convert any fraction a/b to a percentage directly, simply multiply the given fraction by 100. For instance, 1/4 = (1/4) × 100 = 25%.

questions.question: Simplify: (0.7 × 72 ÷ 14 + 6.25 − 8.34 × 0.15 + 5.95)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Apply the BODMAS rule to evaluate multiplication and division first.

First part: 0.7 × 72 ÷ 14 = 50.4 ÷ 14 = 3.6

Second part: 8.34 × 0.15 = 1.251

Substitute the parts back into the equation: 3.6 + 6.25 − 1.251 + 5.95

Add the positive terms together and subtract: 15.80 − 1.251 = 14.549

**∴ The correct answer is 14.549.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression: 0.7 × 72 ÷ 14 + 6.25 − 8.34 × 0.15 + 5.95

**Concept Used:**

BODMAS Rule: Brackets, Order, Division, Multiplication, Addition, and Subtraction.

**Calculations:**

⇒ 0.7 × 72 ÷ 14 + 6.25 − 8.34 × 0.15 + 5.95

⇒ (0.7 × 72) ÷ 14 + 6.25 − (8.34 × 0.15) + 5.95

⇒ 50.4 ÷ 14 + 6.25 − 1.251 + 5.95

⇒ 3.6 + 6.25 − 1.251 + 5.95

Group all the positive values together first to make the addition easier:

⇒ (3.6 + 6.25 + 5.95) − 1.251

⇒ 15.80 − 1.251

⇒ 14.549

**∴ The correct answer is 14.549.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

BODMAS Rule

It specifies the sequence of mathematical operations: Brackets first, then Orders (powers/roots), followed by Division and Multiplication (left to right), and finally Addition and Subtraction (left to right).

Decimal Addition and Subtraction

When adding or subtracting decimal numbers, always align the decimal points precisely before proceeding with the calculation to prevent place-value errors.

Decimal Multiplication

Multiply the numbers as whole integers, then place the decimal point in the resulting product so that it has the exact total number of decimal places present in both of the original factors.

questions.question: The monthly incomes of two friends David and Ashish, are in the ratio 5 : 8, respectively, and each of them saves ₹81,000 every month. If the ratio of their monthly expenditure is 2 : 4, find the monthly income of David (in ₹).
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Income ratio = 5 : 8, Expenditure ratio = 2 : 4 = 1 : 2

Let incomes = 5x, 8x and expenditures = y, 2y

Savings same ⇒ 5x − y = 8x − 2y

⇒ y = 3x

Saving = 5x − 3x = 2x = 81000 ⇒ x = 40500

David’s income = 5x = 202500

**∴ Answer = ₹202500**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Income ratio = 5 : 8; Expenditure ratio = 2 : 4; Savings = 81000 each

**Formula used:**

Income = Expenditure + Savings

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let incomes = 5x and 8x

⇒ Let expenditures = 2y and 4y

⇒ For David: 5x = 2y + 81000

⇒ For Ashish: 8x = 4y + 81000

⇒ Subtract: 8x − 5x = (4y − 2y)

⇒ 3x = 2y ⇒ y = 3x/2

⇒ Put in first equation:

⇒ 5x = 2(3x/2) + 81000

⇒ 5x = 3x + 81000

⇒ 2x = 81000

⇒ x = 40500

⇒ David’s income = 5x = 202500

**∴ The correct answer is ₹202500.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Income Relation

Income = Expenditure + Savings

Ratio Simplification

2 : 4 simplifies to 1 : 2

Equation Method

Form equations using given ratios and solve

Key Insight

Equal savings helps equate expressions

questions.question:
A sphere of radius 14 cm is cut along three diametrical planes to form 6 equal parts. What would be the total surface area (in cm²) of all the new pieces so obtained?

(Take pi = frac {22}{7})
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Original sphere surface area = 4πr² = 4π(14²) = 2464

3 diametrical cuts ⇒ each gives 2 circles ⇒ total new circles = 6

Area of one circle = πr² = 616

New area = 6 × 616 = 3696

Total surface area = 2464 + 3696 = 6160

**∴ Answer = 6160 cm²**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius = 14 cm; π = 22/7

**Formula used:**

Surface area of sphere = 4πr²; Area of circle = πr²

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/acceb116470e866d4e44ed8df7fee062558649b7c129a798e15a0de36e4fee2e.png] 

⇒ Original surface area = 4πr² = 4 × (22/7) × 14² = 2464

⇒ Each diametrical cut creates 2 circular faces

⇒ Total cuts = 3 ⇒ New circular faces = 6

⇒ Area of one circle = πr² = (22/7) × 14² = 616

⇒ Total new surface area = 6 × 616 = 3696

⇒ Total surface area = 2464 + 3696 = 6160

**∴ The correct answer is 6160 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sphere Surface Area

4πr²

Diametrical Plane

Cuts the sphere into equal halves

New Surfaces

Each cut introduces 2 circular faces

Key Idea

Total surface = original curved area + new flat areas

questions.question: ₹4,445 is divided among A, B and C in such a way that if ₹65, ₹39 and ₹77 are deducted from their respective shares, they have money in the ratio 18:3:20. Find the difference between B’s and C’s original shares.

Let remaining shares = 18k : 3k : 20k

Total ⇒ 41k + 181 = 4445

B = 3k + 39 = 351; C = 20k + 77 = 2157

Difference = 2157 − 351 = 1806

**∴ Answer = ₹1806**

⇒ 41k + 181 = 4445

⇒ 41k = 4264

⇒ k = 104

⇒ B = 3k+39 = 351

⇒ C = 20k+77 = 2157

⇒ Difference = 2157 − 351 = 1806

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1806.**
